{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgDHmaJi5eQH1yejwnvgv","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GWZhAVKPxLVxkqrbkptDbx","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /app; python -c \"\nimport pandas as pd, numpy as np\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\ndf=pd.read_csv('dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv')\nnoise=(df.bmi>60)|(df.bmi<10)|(df.avg_glucose_level>800)|(df.avg_glucose_level<20)|(df.age>120)\nd=df[~noise].reset_index(drop=True)\nnum=['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level']\nd['risk_proxy']=np.prod([d[c]/d[c].max() for c in num],axis=0)\ndef mah(cols):\n    X=d[cols].values; mu=X.mean(0); S=np.cov(X,rowvar=False); Si=np.linalg.inv(S)\n    D=np.einsum('ij,jk,ik->i',X-mu,Si,X-mu)\n    crit=chi2.ppf(0.99,len(cols)); return set(d.patient_id[D>crit]), D, crit\na,_,c1=mah(num); b,_,c2=mah(num+['risk_proxy'])\nprint(len(a),c1,len(b),c2,len(a&b))\n# categorical\nfor name,dd in [('orig',df),('clean',d)]:\n    k=dd[(dd.age<=14)&dd.smoking_status.isin(['smokes','formerly smoked'])]\n    w=dd[(dd.work_type=='children')&(dd.age>14)]\n    t=dd[(dd.age<=3)&(dd.work_type=='student')]\n    print(name,len(k),len(w),len(t))\nprint(df[df.work_type=='children'].age.describe())\nprint(df[df.work_type=='student'].age.describe())\nprint(df[df.age<=14].smoking_status.value_counts())\n\"","description":"Compute Mahalanobis and categorical outliers"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":565,"cache_read_input_tokens":28193,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":565,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f8d1d6e9-fd05-4f84-9c78-025483e008b6","uuid":"1fa29da9-26a1-416f-8c03-f33e102299e7","timestamp":"2026-10-20T09:57:09.222Z"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgDHozRLKZbv1BUCtPTdL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01G7SxaDMX1ngEP5HiFy9UHX","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"import numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\n\nDATA_PATH = \"/app/dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv\"\nNUM_COLS = [\"age\", \"bmi\", \"avg_glucose_level\"]\nLIMITS = {\"avg_glucose_level\": (20, 800), \"bmi\": (10, 60), \"age\": (0, 120)}\nALPHA = 0.01\nCHILD_AGE = 14\nTODDLER_AGE = 3\n\n\ndef iqr_mask(s: pd.Series, k: float = 3.0) -> pd.Series:\n    q1, q3 = s.quantile([0.25, 0.75])\n    iqr = q3 - q1\n    return (s < q1 - k * iqr) | (s > q3 + k * iqr)\n\n\ndef to_index(df_orig: pd.DataFrame, ids) -> list[int]:\n    \"\"\"Map patient_ids back to row positions of the original dataset.\"\"\"\n    pos = pd.Series(np.arange(len(df_orig)), index=df_orig[\"patient_id\"])\n    return sorted(int(pos[i]) for i in ids)\n\n\ndef answer() -> list[int]:\n    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)\n    df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()\n    outliers: list[int] = []\n\n    # 1. Technical noise: physically impossible values\n    noise = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)\n    for col, (lo, hi) in LIMITS.items():\n        noise |= (df[col] < lo) | (df[col] > hi)\n    outliers += to_index(df, df.loc[noise, \"patient_id\"])\n    d = df[~noise].copy()\n\n    # 2. Extreme outliers with 3*IQR\n    std_out = pd.Series(False, index=d.index)\n    for col in [\"age\", \"bmi\"]:\n        std_out |= iqr_mask(d[col])\n\n    glu = d[\"avg_glucose_level\"]\n    m = iqr_mask(glu)\n    if m.any():\n        stroke_rate = d.loc[m, \"stroke\"].mean()\n        if stroke_rate >= 0.5:\n            m[:] = False\n        elif stroke_rate > 0.2:\n            m = iqr_mask(np.log2(glu))\n            if m.any() and d.loc[m, \"stroke\"].mean() >= 0.5:\n                m[:] = False\n    std_out |= m\n    outliers += to_index(df, d.loc[std_out, \"patient_id\"])\n    d = d[~std_out].copy()\n\n    # 3. Risk proxy: product of max-normalized numerical features\n    d[\"risk_proxy\"] = np.prod([d[c] / d[c].max() for c in NUM_COLS], axis=0)\n\n    # 4. Multivariate outliers: squared Mahalanobis distance vs chi-square\n    cols = NUM_COLS + [\"risk_proxy\"]\n    X = d[cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)\n    diff = X - X.mean(axis=0)\n    inv_cov = np.linalg.pinv(np.cov(X, rowvar=False))\n    d2 = np.einsum(\"ij,jk,ik->i\", diff, inv_cov, diff)\n    maha = d2 > chi2.ppf(1 - ALPHA, df=len(cols))\n    outliers += to_index(df, d.loc[maha, \"patient_id\"])\n    d = d[~maha].copy()\n\n    # 5. Implausible categorical combinations\n    child = d[\"age\"] <= CHILD_AGE\n    toddler = d[\"age\"] <= TODDLER_AGE\n    cat = (\n        (child & d[\"smoking_status\"].isin([\"smokes\", \"formerly smoked\"]))\n        | (child & d[\"work_type\"].isin([\"Private\", \"Self-employed\", \"Govt_job\"]))\n        | ((d[\"work_type\"] == \"children\") & ~child)\n        | (toddler & (d[\"work_type\"] == \"student\"))\n    )\n    outliers += to_index(df, d.loc[cat, \"patient_id\"])\n\n    seen = set()\n    return [i for i in outliers if not (i in seen or seen.add(i))]\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":369,"cache_read_input_tokens":29876,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":369,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"f8d1d6e9-fd05-4f84-9c78-025483e008b6","uuid":"f3d9f13d-388c-4976-8721-89710090ea6d","timestamp":"2026-10-20T09:57:48.047Z"}
